name: The Second Reproduction ~Reunion~
source:
About a thousand years after an ancient Demon King subdued part of the human continent...

Humanity had grown weary and exhausted, worn down by repeated natural disasters and famines, and by endless conflicts between nations with no end in sight. They were swallowed by grief.

The human king condemned the situation, proclaiming, “It is because of the evil souls of the demonic beings,” and ordered a simultaneous purge of the demon race.

In response, the demon nation “Desraid” adopted a policy of complete isolation, choosing a path of separation from humanity.

Meanwhile, in Desraid’s neighboring country, Almenan, a single princess known as the “Hero” receives an order from her mother, the queen, to set out on a quest to defeat the Demon King.

Chanting that “demons are evil,” she raises her sword in the name of the justice she believes in...

This is a love story that embraces ruin—the tale of those who struggle within such chaos.

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/sr/sien/]the official website[/url].]
